text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You couldn't get a single one...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I guess ya just kinda suck.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Sometimes I don't even know<n>what to do
with you! We're comin'<n>back here another day so I
can show<n>ya how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The great Windy'll teach ya a few<n>tricks, capisce?!
